svg.title: End-to-End Agent Hub Flow
svg.desc: Fixed vertical layout of all 34 original nodes and 46 connections. User request starts at the top. Idempotency check and Close execution are at the bottom.

g.title: Agent Hub extracts goal, inputs, scope, constraints
Validate Registry status, capability, permission, tools
User selects Agent or Agent set
Check whether existing Agents can compose
Agent Creator searches approved external reuse
Hub requests confirmation before adoption or creation
Hub presents ordered Blueprint, dependencies, and outputs
Confirm Agent, goal, input, permission scope
Preview target, records, content, timing, identity
Present completed, failed, skipped, IDs, rollback
Present error, retryability, and required confirmation
Check idempotency and prior external result
